amendments.done_when: The session-rounds test reads Forge's output the same on Windows as on Linux, and every Windows full-suite group finishes within its limit

done_when: The session-rounds test accepts either line ending after the checkout path, and Windows full-suite groups get a 45-minute limit

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The change sets the Windows job limit to 45 minutes, but the named proof only checks that configured number. It gives no result showing that all eight Windows full-suite groups finish within it; the proof list defers that result to a future run. The full-suite job skips pull requests (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:47`), while the pull-request test job is Linux-only (`.github/workflows/forge.yml:24`), so the pending pull-request checks cannot establish this Done-when clause.
